_readme: RESUME PAGE. Sections appear in the order they are listed here, so you can reorder or delete them freely. Each section either pulls in shared content ("source": "education" | "projects" | "skills", taken from content/about.json, content/projects/ and content/skills.json) or holds its own items. A section with no items and no emptyState is not shown at all. To hide a section that currently only shows a placeholder, delete its emptyState line. Item shape: {"title": "", "subtitle": "", "date": "", "body": "", "bullets": [""], "links": [{"label": "", "file": "documents/..." or "url": "https://..."}]}
heading: Resume
intro: A web version of my academic record. The same document is available as a PDF for use in applications.

items.title: Family Journeys Co-Lab — University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
items.subtitle: Research Assistant, Developmental Psychopathology
bullets: Conducted abstract screening for a systematic review of the developmental internalizing pathway to substance use disorders, classifying 100+ papers in Covidence across six developmental components of the framework.
Participated in a campus seminar series on substance use disorders and its intersections.

Evaluated program data for 22 adolescents in the Reintegration Support Network, integrating referral, risk-assessment, mentor-interaction, evaluation and interview records into a 29-page final report.

items.title: Neuroethology Lab — Ashoka University
items.subtitle: Research Assistant, Quantitative Cognition in Zebrafish
bullets: Developed experimental paradigms for zebrafish quantity discrimination, including a dot-splitting paradigm and a ratio-comparison task in a T-maze.
Built the apparatus and visual stimuli, ran 20+ behavioral trials, and coded behavioral data in BORIS.
Reviewed 15+ studies, presented the findings to the lab, and contributed to a publication proposal.

items.title: Professor Naseer's Lab — Ashoka University
items.subtitle: Research Intern, Scale Adaptation for Drug Abuse Screening
bullets: Reviewed culturally adapted substance-use assessments to inform adaptation of the DAST-10 in Hindi, and refined the study design and methodology.
Drafted protocols and flowcharts for cross-cultural adaptation and psychometric validation, including complementary measures (ASSIST, PHQ-9, GAD-7).
Designed a Qualtrics survey on religious values and moral decision-making.

items.title: RELA Hospital and Institute
items.subtitle: Clinical Psychology Intern
bullets: Administered, scored and interpreted MoCA/MMSE assessments and conducted Mental Status Examinations for 5+ patients under supervision.
Joined clinical assessment and case discussions with clinical psychologists and psychiatrists on CBT, ACT, family and grief counseling.
Followed up with 20+ living liver donors by structured assessment calls to assess post-donation recovery.
Observed counseling and outpatient consultations across liver transplantation, neurological ICU, palliative care, and medical and radiation oncology.

items.title: Gaming & Cognition (PSY-4022)
items.subtitle: Teaching Assistant
bullets: Ran office hours on course concepts and project ideas, and compiled supplementary resources.
Facilitated discussion sections alongside the Teaching Fellow and supported course projects on game development and game-based learning.
Graded quizzes and provided feedback on lectures.

items.title: Ashoka Behavioral Insights Team
items.subtitle: Head of Department / Chief Editor, The Nudgelet
items.body: Led a 20+ member team publishing accessible articles on everyday phenomena, drawn from behavioral science research.
bullets: Authored "Are You in Love, or Just Afraid of Being Single?" after designing and analyzing a campus survey of 37 responses on relationship FOMO.
Wrote entries on optimism bias and the voluntariness principle for the Centre for Social & Behavioral Change's A–Z of Behavioral Science handbook.

items.title: Ashoka Debating Union
items.subtitle: President
bullets: Led a community of 80+ debaters, organizing mock debates, inter-varsity competitions and training sessions with the Indian Debating League.
Debated in 25+ parliamentary rounds as speaker and adjudicator.

items.title: Dean's List Student
items.subtitle: Ashoka University
items.body: Named to the Dean's List every semester to date.

items.title: School Topper / Head Boy
items.subtitle: The PSBB Millennium School, Chennai
items.body: Ranked first in class with a perfect score in Biology; president of the Model UN Society and a member of disciplinary committees.
